confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee prices come from aggregated cost-of-living data found in web searches (Numbeo, Citycost, mid-2026 to Oct 2026). Those sources put a cappuccino at about EUR 1.8, an inexpensive meal at about EUR 18 and a mid-range meal for two at about EUR 71. The beer anchor is a 0.5 L domestic draught, listed at EUR 5-6.25. Prices were converted to USD at about 1.10 USD per EUR, a rate implied by the RBA's AUD/USD and AUD/EUR cross rates. No direct aggregated figures for cocktails or wine came up in the searches, so those two are estimated from typical Italian bar prices and their usual relationship to beer prices. All four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge for the July peak season, when Pisa has heavy day-trip and Tuscany tourism. No booking pages or current listings were checked, so these are the least certain anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: Pisa is a mid-sized Tuscan university and tourist city. Prices are similar to or slightly below Florence and broadly in line with Lucca and other central-northern Italian cities. July summer demand raises hotel and hostel rates.
